resources.string: Turn the magnetic keyboard and touchpad on or off
Keyboard and touchpad ignore all input
Turning this off inhibits the input devices in the kernel. The keyboard stays physically attached and charging; it simply stops reporting keys, pointer movement and wake events.
Huawei Histen processing for the built-in speakers
Media played on the built-in speakers is processed

Experimental. Only media audio (music, video, games) on the built-in speakers is processed; headphones, Bluetooth and USB audio are never touched. Turning it on applies from the next playback; turning it off applies within about a second. If the sound is distorted or cuts out, turn it off.
